content: If you have skin conditions such as atopic dermatitis or eczema, you should minimize your exposure to sunlight. Avoid using tanning booths and sunlamps. When outdoors, apply sunscreen and wear protective clothing to shield your skin. This medication contains sodium and is chemically similar to aspirin. Children and teenagers under the age of 18 should not take aspirin if they have chickenpox, the flu, any undiagnosed illness, or if they have recently received a vaccine, as it may increase the risk of Reye's syndrome. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if absolutely necessary, as determined by your doctor. It is also important to note that this medication may pass into breast milk, so consult your healthcare provider if you are breastfeeding. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Keep a detailed list of all the products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. Balsalazide is closely related to mesalamine and may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as urine normetanephrine levels, potentially leading to inaccurate results. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services immediately (911 in the U.S.). Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222 for assistance. While taking this medication, your doctor may order laboratory tests, such as kidney and liver function tests, to monitor your health. Be sure to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
